handoff.objective: Implement and execute the frozen, APPROVED contract EXP-ECRANK-52d039 version 1 (experiments/EXP-ECRANK-52d039/ specification.yaml; status approved, approved_by coordinator, per DEC-20260908-d5057a) EXACTLY as written. Three enumerated runs in the frozen order. R1, the abstract gate, control admission first, C1 (A0, the zero-width identity matrix) must return INDEPENDENT with all pivot lower bounds exactly 1 and determinant 1 before any other reading; then the 29 frozen object-width runs over the machine-verified abstract object set (A1 at widths 2^-10 and 2^-30; A2 on the width schedule w(n) = 2^-10 * 4^-n for n = 0 to 16, reporting (n*, n_cert) with n* computed at run start by the INDEPENDENT verifier implementation; A3 at both widths with the explicit positive definite box member re-derived at run start; A4 the inward-rounded known-false object, which must be REJECTED by the enclosure-derivation check; G_dep under the three frozen order permutations at both widths, which must never return INDEPENDENT), with the C6 producer-verifier exact agreement and blind re-derivation on every run. R2, the elliptic interface gate, selects the named curve by the frozen candidate-list rule (first candidate passing all four run-start exact checks, every check for every candidate archived), derives C(E) exactly with every inequality an exact rational check, blind-re-derives C(E) in the independent verifier, then certifies O1, the singleton {P} grounded by the Mazur non-torsion control (never by the certificate), over n = 0 to n_max = 60, and runs O2, the pair {P, 2P} dependent by exact construction, which must never return INDEPENDENT at any n, with the comparison-only floating regulator cross-check whose positive determinant on O2 is the pre- registered collision event, recorded and never read into a verdict. R3 replays R1 and R2 in a fresh process and must reproduce every verdict, pivot lower bound, n_cert, n*, the C(E) value, and the certificate witness bytes bit-for-bit. The frozen contract is the ONLY protocol. The Executor records observations only, interprets nothing, selects no interpretation branch, uses no hypothesis language in run records, and changes no status.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the rational interval Schur witness is sound at abstract scale (M-A, the four controls plus zero unwitnessed or dependent- object INDEPENDENT verdicts); whether its certification power meets the independently derived sufficient bound (M-B, the (n*, n_cert) pairs and the n_cert <= n* theorem of the stated mechanism); and whether the elliptic interface works end to end on one small named curve (M-C, the exact C(E) derivation, the O1 certification at a reported n_cert, the O2 never-certified property, and the cross-check sign agreement). This task records measurements; it decides nothing.
inputs: experiments/EXP-ECRANK-52d039/specification.yaml (the frozen approved contract -- the ONLY protocol)

constraints: The frozen contract is the ONLY protocol. Any needed change is a FURTHER versioned protocol_amendment proposed to the Coordinator -- never an inline edit of the contract or an executed run; never a re-score.
Stdlib only (fractions.Fraction); no PARI; no Magma; no descent; no network; no third-party package. descent_calls 0; pari_ellrank_calls 0.

Exact rational arithmetic throughout the verdict path; no floating point in any verdict. Floating point is permitted ONLY in the R2 comparison-only regulator cross-check, and its value never enters a verdict.
The log enclosure must be a rigorous rational interval with a mechanically checkable exact certificate of the remainder bound; all interval arithmetic outward on exact rationals.

The independent verifier shares NO code with the producer pipeline; it re-derives enclosures, pivot lower bounds, verdicts, and (R2) C(E) from declarations and parameters alone (blind_from the producer implementation, its notes, and its report).

Run-start exact facts (pivots, margins, box membership, explicit positive definite box members, n*) are recomputed exactly and archived BEFORE any verdict is read; a mismatch is a spec defect, the affected run invalid, correction by amendment.

Full artifact policy per run under experiments/EXP-ECRANK-52d039/runs/<RUN-ID>/, nested run record carrying RUN_REQUIRED_TOP, plus command.txt, environment.json, stdout.log, stderr.log, raw-result.json, manifest.yaml.
Exhaustion is reported as exhaustion (rules 3 and 5); a cap breach is never re-scored as positive or negative.
ZERO interpretation: no branch selection, no conclusion about HEUR-1, no status change, no hypothesis language in run records.
Workers never commit; write only inside write_scope. Record actual resolved model/runtime provenance; never fabricate timings, counts, or receipts (rule 9); Bedrock is prohibited (rule 16).
completion_gate: All 3 runs finalized with the nested run record schema, or a recorded control-admission stop with all receipts preserved.
C1-C6 reported exactly per their frozen expectations, with every INDEPENDENT verdict carrying its complete exact witness and the verifier re-derivation.
The run-start derivation artifact and the C(E) derivation + blind re-derivation archived.
The per-run cost ledgers itemize every charged component (doubling-coordinate growth per chain, log enclosure, factorization, verification, peak memory).
validate_ledger.py adds no new violations on the new records.

handoff.uncertainty_reduced: What the committed k=3/k=4 coset optimisation actually produces on the certified high-rank base curves that did not exist when the question was asked: the best k=3 certificate score on the frozen 32-base pool (P1), whether the coset total separates from the base rank (P2 slope and interval), the residual base-rank number R* after the best k=3 coset is taken per base, with bootstrap interval (P3, the C2 quantity of GOAL-ECRANK-002), the best k=4 score (P4), and how alarm censoring at 30 s versus 240 s skews the high-rank arm (R3). constraints: The frozen contract is the only authority; no run is authorized outside it.
